sourcePath.fact: LOGIN source declares one secret reference, seeds authentic scoped provider and successfully learns/publishes under declared source scope.

Replay principal comes from original authenticated Core userId; binding scope principal and grant principal are set to that principal. Actual grant is fresh and bounded at authorization, with required identities/hashes copied before acceptance.
Original locked acceptance checks test/revision/CSI/environment/artifact identity and calls check(binding); successful acceptance precedes the later dispatch refusal.

Named holder is accepted first, secret is accepted/binding-asserted and watched, then authentic holder dispatch and entered/ADMITTED/no-browser/no-secret-read checks complete before secret dispatchOnce.

sourceFirstGuardAlternatives.fact: A genuine observed binding takes dispatchObserved before legacy authorization.recheck; legacy refusal log/code cannot be borrowed as this first cause.
refreshRetry refusal closes before resolving/sending; exact original exception code is mapped and discarded.
No matching retry token returns accepted binding unchanged; real fresh retry authority requires the existing owned/token/no-admission predicates.

check independently requires enabled/schema/pins, grant expiry, scope/current-policy hash equality, grant/binding identity tuple and build/profile hashes, then current owner not cancelled/revoked/DONE.
Job runs check and immutable revision verification before resolving accepted declarations with binding principal/CSI/environment/test and committed read-entry callback.
Actual mayUse refusal before a value read or after resolution yields SecretUseRevokedException. Constant fixture entitlement should permit the declared tuple; actual invoked tuple is not retained.

Typed resolver refusal maps AUTHORIZATION_REVOKED; generic mapped messages include AUTHORIZATION_EXPIRED, FORBIDDEN_SCOPE, SECRET_USE_REVOKED and SECRET_USE_NOT_AUTHORIZED. Recorded current revoked_at can override the mapped cause in settlement. Outer code alone distinguishes none of these.

timingLimit.inference: Accepted-to-ended elapsed alone cannot establish grant age, an expiry breach, actual policy-hash mismatch or denied entitlement.

conclusion.proven: Secret dispatch closes without actual client invocation/admission before authentic429 and retry; holder was actually accepted. Fixture source explicitly permits its declared principal pairs and secret tuple.
notProven: Not demonstrated grant expiry or forbidden scope/hash mismatch.
Not holder browser failure or later cleanup cancellation as the secret first cause.
No source or retained artifact basis to relax any guard or extend a deadline.

missingDefiningEvidence: Original fixed exception code at first observed dispatch refusal
Exact same-attempt binding/grant/principal/reference equality facts at that boundary
Original grant issue/expiry/check timestamps and recorded owner revocation flag before closure
privacy: Private generated fixture inspection only; no values, raw configurations/bodies/credentials, identity strings or runtime paths exported.
